slides.headline:
The *7 players*
in every
Cape Town 5s
slides.sub: Tag yours. Be honest about which one you are.

slides.title: The *“five minutes away”*
slides.body: Has been five minutes away since 18:10.

slides.title: The *keeper who won't stay*
slides.body: In goal for one minute. Then at striker.

slides.title: The *“next goal wins”* guy
slides.body: Says it at 3–0 down. Every week.

slides.title: The *bib collector*
slides.body: Washes them, brings them, gets no thanks.

slides.title: The *ringer's ringer*
slides.body: “My mate's coming.” Nobody has met this mate.

slides.title: The *organiser*
slides.body: Does all of the above. Holds the whole thing together.

slides.headline:
Every game
needs an
*organiser*.
slides.body: We're building a free tool to make their week easier. Cape Town first.
